note: Current setup in one place. Account owners, sign-ins and recovery live in the private 'Library accounts (private).md' in the library ChatGPT Maintenance project (Sources), never in this public repository. Check every entry against the actual connection before promising access.

liveWebsite.hosting: Cloudflare Pages project cottonwood-library on the library's Cloudflare account. Deploy scripts refuse any other account (scripts/library-account.mjs). The live deploy token keeps the legacy secret name CLOUDFLARE_TRIAL_API_TOKEN.
liveWebsite.flow: preview → live. Previews are immutable <8hex>.cottonwood-library.pages.dev uploads; the live website is the production deployment of the same project.
liveWebsite.workflows: publish-live.yml (PR preview and live save), cms.yml (CMS preview and administrator recovery), live-hosting-setup.yml (one-time project creation)

chatgpt.plugin: Cottonwood Library. The source version is in plugins/cottonwood-library/plugin.json. Changing plugins/ does not update the installed plugin; upload the new version in the library ChatGPT account, then check the installed version there.
chatgpt.codexEnvironment: cottonwood-library-editor (the only Codex environment). Setup: scripts/cloud-setup.sh and assistant/START.md.
chatgpt.weeklyReview: Weekly Maintenance Check, Monday around 14:00 Pacific, posting into the Maintenance project (assistant/tasks/README.md). Confirm it is enabled before promising a run.
chatgpt.connections: Official Sanity, Givebutter (read-only) and GitHub connections, plus the Library Analytics report connector (connector/README.md). Keep the connector on Allow read-only tools.

maintenance.repairs: upkeep.yml; renew its sign-in with the Reconnect automatic repairs issue (assistant/MAINTENANCE.md)
maintenance.reports: Written to the maintenance-reports branch; never delete it.
